page.overview:
Who is Feyd II?

Emperor Feyd II (d. 1099) was briefly Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1099 AG), succeeding his father Estil II as ruler of the Imperium.

Feyd II became emperor in 1099, after the death of his father Estil II. By this time, only a few worlds remained under the control of the Feyd regime, most having been lost to the rebels supporting a restoration of House Corrino. Feyd was murdered by his own officers after ruling for only two weeks. In his place, the Corrino heir Josif I was named emperor, ending the rule of the House of Feyd.
